summary: W.W.J.D. backend: 23/23 pytest tests PASS against the public preview URL. Primary AI feature (Claude Sonnet 4.6 counsel stream) verified end-to-end with real, on-topic Gospel-grounded output (2189 chars, refs: Matthew 18:21-22, Matthew 18:33, Matthew 5:23-24, Luke 23:34, Matthew 6:12, Matthew 7:7-8) and persistence in mongo. Prayer generation, gating (403 for non-activated user), diary CRUD (per-user scoping), save-counsel, daily scripture, Stripe test checkout (cs_test_... session, pending payment status), gift activation error paths, testimony upload via Emergent object storage + retrieval via /api/files, all pass. Skills loaded: ai-testing-core, ai-testing-llm.
feature_verdicts: auth register/login/me/duplicate/invalid - pass - HTTP 200/400/401 as expected; has_access=false for new user, true for admin - command: pytest tests/test_wwjd_backend.py::TestAuth
daily scripture GET /api/scripture/daily - pass - returns quote/reference/invitation/date

counsel stream POST /api/counsel/stream (primary AI, Claude Sonnet 4.6) - pass - SSE 200 text/event-stream, meta+delta+done events, 2189-char reply quoting Jesus with 6 scripture refs (Matthew 18:21-22 etc.); conversation persisted and retrievable - skill: ai-testing-llm
counsel gating (fresh user) - pass - POST /api/counsel/stream returns 403 'This gift has not been activated yet.'
pray-this-with-me POST /api/counsel/pray - pass - real first-person prayer 'Father, I come to you honest...' generated by Claude Sonnet 4.6
save one counsel POST/GET/DELETE /api/counsel/save[d] - pass - full round-trip
diary CRUD POST/GET/PUT/DELETE /api/diary - pass - per-user scoping enforced (fresh user can't see/update admin entries; 404 on cross-user PUT)
gift checkout POST /api/gifts/checkout - pass - returned real Stripe test session_id cs_test_a1NOM7AGTcYflBxR0z... and https://checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/... URL
payment status GET /api/payments/status/{id} - pass - payment_status='pending', activation_code hidden until paid
gift activate error paths POST /api/gifts/activate - pass - 404 for invalid code, 400 for pending code
testimonies POST + updates + GET /api/files/{path} - pass - upload succeeded via Emergent object storage, file retrievable with binary content-type, 404 for unknown path
stripe config GET /api/config/stripe - pass - publishable_key starts with pk_test_..., price_usd=1

minor.issue: Returns {} (empty object) when no saved counsel exists; would be cleaner to return null or a consistent shape, but current behavior is documented and matches frontend expectation.

SSE 'delta' payload builds JSON via string concatenation with only \, " and \n escaped. Any control char (\r, \t, unicode line separators) from the model could break JSON.parse on the client. Consider json.dumps for the whole envelope.
No size/type validation on uploaded video; large files would tie up worker for up to 180s (put_object timeout). Recommend max size + allowed mime-type check.
Anyone with a valid auth token can add updates to any testimony (no author check). Not enforced yet.
Public (unauthenticated) endpoint; acceptable for public 'Stories of Freedom' videos but there is no admin/soft-delete guard - is_deleted testimonies still have their video_path served.
allow_origins is a single FRONTEND_URL; if the app is opened via a different preview URL (localhost, custom domain) browser credential auth would break. Fine for MVP.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~717 lines with many concerns (auth, LLM, gifts, testimonies, storage). Consider splitting into routers/ modules before it grows further.
SSE delta encoding in counsel_stream uses manual string concatenation and only escapes \, ", \n - safer to json.dumps({'type':'delta','content':event.content}).
No rate limiting or brute-force lockout on POST /api/auth/login (auth_testing playbook expects lockout after 5 fails). Consider adding.
activate_gift grants 30 days flat regardless of previous subscription_expires_at; stacking multiple gifts overwrites rather than extends. May be intentional but worth confirming with product.
add_testimony_update is unrestricted to any authenticated user; should verify request.user is the testimony owner (or admin).
Uploaded video mime-type/size not validated - possible abuse of object storage quota.
/api/files/{path} serves testimonies even if is_deleted=true (soft-delete not honored).
seed_data_creation: Created (and cleaned up in-flight) TEST_ diary entries, one pending gift (cs_test_a1NOM7AGTcYflBxR0z...) that remains as an unpaid Stripe test session, one testimony named 'TEST_Storyteller' with a 156-byte dummy .mp4 uploaded to object storage under wwjd/testimonies/<id>/...mp4. These do NOT affect production and can be left in place.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is stable; /app/backend/tests/test_wwjd_backend.py can be re-run as a full regression via `pytest tests/test_wwjd_backend.py -v`. It hits the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, exercises the real Claude Sonnet 4.6 (~30-40s per turn), the real Stripe test key (creates cs_test_ sessions each run but never charges), and the Emergent object storage. Test data is prefixed TEST_ for easy cleanup. If frontend testing is added later, the Stripe test card is 4242 4242 4242 4242 but do NOT complete real Checkout in a headless browser (per review request).
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found in the tested surface.
